ios.desc:
Create beautiful professional resume in minutes. Writing good resume is 80% of landing a job. It shouldn't be hard creating a resume. When you create a resume it contains an example so it's very easy to start and edit the template.

The application allows you:
- use voice typing to create your resume
- create and save multiple resumes
- search for created resume using Spotlight Search
- create custom fields and sections
- reorder and delete sections
- use variety of templates
- share using File Sharing or directly to iCloud
- the app has been designed with accessibility in mind. All elements are accessible via voice over so anyone can use the app
- dark/light mode support
- dynamic font support. Select font size that's most convenient for you to read
